title: Provable one-poison backdoor attacks on linear models and ReLU neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2508.05600v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Backdoor poisoning attacks are a threat to machine learning models that are trained on data collected from untrusted sources; these attacks enable attackers to inject malicious behavior into the model that can be triggered by specially crafted inputs. Prior work has established bounds on the success of backdoor attacks and their impact on the benign learning task, however, an open question is what amount of poison data is needed for a successful backdoor attack. Typical attacks either use few samples but need much information about the data points, or need to poison many data points.   In this paper, we show that an adversary can mount a one-poison backdoor attack without knowledge of individual training data, requiring only coarse geometric bounds of the input space and training parameters. We identify provably sufficient conditions that allow an adversary with one poison sample with high probability to inject a backdoor into linear

translated_title: 可证明的线性模型和ReLU神经网络单毒样本后门攻击
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.05600v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：后门投毒攻击对从不可信来源收集数据训练的机器学习模型构成威胁；这些攻击使攻击者能够向模型中注入恶意行为，该行为可通过特制输入触发。先前的研究已建立了后门攻击成功概率及其对良性学习任务影响的界限，然而，一个开放问题是成功进行后门攻击所需的投毒数据量。典型攻击要么使用少量样本但需要大量关于数据点的信息，要么需要投毒大量数据点。在本文中，我们表明，攻击者可以在不了解单个训练数据的情况下发动单毒样本后门攻击，仅需输入空间和训练参数的粗略几何边界。我们确定了可证明的充分条件，使得拥有一个毒样本的攻击者能够以高概率将后门注入线性模型。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需知晓单个训练数据、仅凭输入空间和训练参数的粗略几何信息即可用单个毒样本成功实施后门攻击的可证明方法，填补了投毒数据量需求的理论空白。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a provable one-poison backdoor attack that requires only coarse geometric bounds of the input space and training parameters, without knowledge of individual training data, filling the theoretical gap on the minimal poison data needed for successful attacks.
